# TPC-DS-OBT Q25

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds_obt
```

> [TPC-DS-OBT](../../tpc-ds-obt.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS-OBT queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT item_i_item_id, item_i_item_desc, store_s_store_id, store_s_store_name, SUM(net_profit) AS store_sales_profit, SUM(return_net_loss) AS store_returns_loss, SUM(net_profit) AS catalog_sales_profit FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE (sold_date_d_moy = 4 AND sold_date_d_year = 1998 AND sold_date_d_date_sk = sold_date_sk AND item_i_item_sk = item_sk AND store_s_store_sk = store_sk AND ship_customer_sk = returning_customer_c_customer_sk AND item_sk = item_sk AND sale_id = sale_id AND returned_date_sk = return_date_d_date_sk AND return_date_d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10 AND return_date_d_year = 1998 AND returning_customer_c_customer_sk = bill_customer_sk AND item_sk = item_sk AND sold_date_sk = sold_date_d_date_sk AND sold_date_d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10 AND sold_date_d_year = 1998) AND channel IN ('catalog', 'store') GROUP BY item_i_item_id, item_i_item_desc, store_s_store_id, store_s_store_name ORDER BY item_i_item_id, item_i_item_desc, store_s_store_id, store_s_store_name LIMIT 100
```
